repairs.quote: Aatrox fires a chain, Slowing the first enemy hit by 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% for 1.5 seconds and dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + (40% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Champions and large jungle monsters have 1.5 seconds to leave the impact area or be Pulled back to the center and damaged again for the same amount. Deals double damage to minions.

proposalDecisions.reason: 기본 피해에도 첫 적중 조건 추가.
1.5초 이전에 끌어오는 LTE를 제거하고 탈출창 종료 시 실패로 텍스트 보존.
